Standard Maintenance Procedure

How the Maintenance Department plans, executes, records and reviews maintenance. Every document reference is live from the Document Master, so numbers and revisions update automatically. Print includes the controlled-document block.

Document Master: Document Control Register (IATF 16949 Cl. 7.5)

One register linked to every master and printable format. Each document carries its Issue Date, Revision No. and Revision Date. A new Revision No. needs a change description and a Revision Date later than the previous one. Doc No. is locked: only the Admin can unlock it with the Admin password. These details print at the top of every printout.

Formula: Scheduled hours = Machines × 24 × days in period (minimum 30 days = 720 hrs/machine/month). Uptime = Scheduled hours − Downtime. MTBF = Uptime ÷ Number of failures. Machines with no failures show their full uptime.

      Data links: Breakdown Master (MTTR, MTBF, downtime, causes) • Machine Master (machine list, plant, scheduled hours) • Plant Master (plant filter) • PM Schedule (overdue PM) • Spare Parts Inventory (low stock) • Work Orders (open WOs). Formulas: Scheduled hrs = Machines × Hrs/day × Days. MTTR = Downtime ÷ Breakdowns. MTBF = (Scheduled − Downtime) ÷ Breakdowns. Availability = (Scheduled − Downtime) ÷ Scheduled. Change % compares with the previous period of equal length.

      Full Data Backup & Restore

      Download one file with all CMMS data: masters, breakdowns, work orders, history, PM, team, shifts, inventory, users, documents, photos and settings. Upload that file to restore everything. Admin only.

      Download backup

      Saves a .json file to this device (Downloads folder on Android).

      Upload / restore backup

      Replaces all current data with the data in the file. A safety backup of the current data is downloaded first. Admin password required.

      The backup file contains user login data (encrypted passwords). Keep it private and store copies in a safe place.

      Report Automation – Email, WhatsApp & SMS

      Set who receives maintenance reports, which channel each person uses, and the schedule. Admin only.

      Sender (From)

      The SMTP password is never stored in this browser. Set it on the server as the environment variable CMMS_SMTP_PASSWORD.

      Reports & Schedule

      Recipients & Channels

      NameEmailMobile (with country code) EmailWhatsAppSMSBreakdown alertsWO closure confirmAction

      "Send now" opens the selected app on this device with the report text ready: Email opens your mail app, WhatsApp opens a chat, SMS opens a message. You tap send. For fully automatic sending, use the Python scheduler (cmms_auto_report.py) with the exported config and snapshot.

      Automatic Breakdown Alerts

      When a breakdown is logged, the CMMS sends it to the Alert Server, which emails, WhatsApps or texts everyone ticked under "Breakdown alerts" above. If the server cannot be reached, a popup with one-tap buttons appears instead.

      The token must match the server's CMMS_ALERT_TOKEN. Use the server only on a trusted network or behind HTTPS. Email and Twilio passwords stay on the server.
